Strawberry Newspaper (Ichigo Shimbun)

Sanrio’s own magazine, published since April 1975: character news, manga, recipes, and cut-out crafts for readers called “Strawberry Mates”.

Source
Wikipedia: Strawberry Newspaper
Creator
Sanrio
Made
1975 to the present (first issue April 1975)
Style
Kawaii (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Cute, playful, friendly
Evidence
Relies on the Wikipedia article. No issue was inspected; covers seen only as small shop thumbnails were not used.
Reviewed
2 October 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

Wikipedia says the first issue was published in April 1975 with Snoopy on the cover and cost 100 yen. It appeared twice a month and became monthly in 1982. By 2019, 600 issues had been published, each printed in 100,000 copies according to Sanrio. Wikipedia: Strawberry Newspaper.

The magazine carries news about Sanrio characters and products, drawing lessons, origami, manga serials, character recipes, paper crafts, and cut-out games. It uses a large tabloid format printed in full color, with a poster and a bonus item in each issue. Readers have helped name new characters, starting with the Little Twin Stars in 1975. Wikipedia: Strawberry Newspaper.

Why it belongs

The magazine is the editorial side of the style: it made Sanrio’s characters a serial world that readers took part in, not just decorations on goods.

What to review next

  • Find an open or museum image of an early issue (1975–1985) and record its layout, color, and type.
